subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs as the disabled-by-default canonical way to bound wedged deferred turn maintenance, or choose another recovery policy before merge?
rationale: The patch is a credible fix, but it adds a public config surface and defines how timed-out plugin maintenance may continue in the background while session state is fenced.

options.title: Accept opt-in timeout
options.body: Merge this design as the canonical opt-in maintenance bound after maintainer review of the config name, timeout semantics, and fence coverage.

options.title: Revise timeout policy
options.body: Ask for the same source-level fix to use a different policy, such as reusing the compaction safety budget or avoiding a new config key.

options.title: Pause for canonical PR choice
options.body: Hold this PR while maintainers choose between #97175, #100103, #101702, or a maintainer rewrite for the deferred-maintenance recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in timeout
recommendation.body: Merge this design as the canonical opt-in maintenance bound after maintainer review of the config name, timeout semantics, and fence coverage.
